## Requirements: Pages offline-first Lineage Projector and bounded Acceptance/E2E evidence (#1906 Phase 2-C4)

**Parent #1906; #1782.** This is a deployable *partial* public trust contract. #1918 has completed authenticated result v2 at producer, but live `agent-store` is unprovisioned and has no authenticated producer result. No verified Issue→PR→Slice edges may be published from fixtures.

### Scope
1. Independent, versioned, allowlisted read-only Lineage Projector under `pages/`. Per Issue/PR edges use explicit `verified/unlinked` and evidence identity (Issue, PR, head SHA at attestation, Run/Attempt, Action ID vs separate Slice). The projector must reject raw or untrusted relation input, missing/ambiguous/cross-repo/replay/stale SHA/partial/duplicate proof and never join by Issue number, Timeline mention or coincidental SHA. Lack of a producer source stays `Unlinked`.
2. A bounded source adapter for **existing canonical acceptance-results** indexed E2E records: pin read-only checkout SHA, reject symlinks/dirty/drift/unbounded files, re-verify source repo/event/workflow Run/Attempt/head SHA against independently read GitHub Actions, record SHA-256 and exact referenced path. Export only safe E2E ID/Pass/Fail/Run evidence, maintaining null/Unknown for actual SC Acceptance. This source is an E2E receipt, **never an SC result**.
3. Public standalone Issue and PR evidence views show independent bounded source coverage, same-HEAD per-ID E2E when proved, explicit SC Acceptance Unavailable/Unknown (until a canonical authenticated SC source exists), verified-only causal links (currently none). No product `web/`, browser GitHub token/API, raw orphan payload, new writer/SC projector.
4. Deterministic negative/unit/browser tests: v1→v2 missing origin, spoofed relation, swapped/duplicate/different attempt, stale SHA/PR, old approvals, pagination/truncated/unavailable, unsafe paths/symlink, corrupted digest, untrusted Issue text and no current-source ambiguity. Exact-head CI/Acceptance gates required independently.
5. Parent #1906 remains Open until a real protected v2 producer and logical Slice/SC source is authenticated; #1690 strong store claims stay separate.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Public versioned lineage/edge projection produces only authenticated provenance-backed edges; without trusted real producer, emits honest Unlinked/Unknown and rejects arbitrary candidate v2 payload.
- [ ] SC-02 Canonical read-only pinned E2E Acceptance Store reader verifies exact Run/Attempt/head SHA, source schema, matching plan/artifact digests, Issue E2E projection receipt and independently authenticated GitHub Test/Ingest workflows with bounded partial/missing source. The selected Issue-E2E records have no by-SHA index; never claim an indexed provenance path, audited Store integrity or SC Pass.
- [ ] SC-03 Independent Pages drilldown renders per-ID source links, provenance status, explicit SC Unknown, and preserves the existing safe view/mobile/refresh contract.
- [ ] SC-04 Negative fixtures and selected E2E cover cross-repo, stale/duplicate/partial/drift/unsafe data; exact PR HEAD Pages CI, Quality Gate, Case Smoke, E2E and read-only Agent evaluation pass.

- [x] #1906/#1782 parent acceptance separately controlled.
